Entry requirements · 2027 entry

Computer Science BS at Georgia Tech

What Georgia Tech asks of applicants to Computer Science BS for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

US · All Georgia Tech courses · Computer Science field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 7 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • SAT or ACT required — all first-year applicants
  • ACT writing section and SAT optional essay not required

Georgia Tech’s admissions pages apply to all first-year applicants; applicants do not apply to a specific major or college (the intended major is considered in review).

Verified19 Oct 2026Georgia Tech: Standardized Tests · Georgia Tech: Standardized Tests
English language
  • All international applicants must demonstrate English proficiency by one of the University System of Georgia (USG) approved methods
  • USG minimum scores for admission:
    • TOEFL iBT 3.5 (69 if taken before 2026), IELTS Academic 6
    • USG recommended scores: TOEFL iBT 4.0 (79 if taken before 2026), IELTS Academic 6.5
  • Duolingo English Test and InitialView/Vericant interviews are welcomed as supplements but do not satisfy the USG requirement

The score table is on the University System of Georgia page that Georgia Tech links to; USG lets institutions set higher scores, and Georgia Tech’s pages state none. USG also lists other approved methods (e.g. SAT EBRW 480, ACT English 17, Cambridge, PTE, a waiver for completed English-medium study).

Verified19 Oct 2026Georgia Tech: International First-Year Admission · University System of Georgia: USG English Proficiency Requirements
Admissions tests

None listed on the official source

No course-specific admissions test is listed. The only major-specific requirement on the major-selection page is a portfolio and essay for Music Technology, which does not apply to this course.

Verified19 Oct 2026Georgia Tech: Major Selection in the Application Process
Subject prerequisites
  • Not used in Altiora’s matching yet — see the note for the official guidance

Official: the University System of Georgia requires minimum high-school courses of all first-time students graduating from a U.S. high school — English 4 units, Math 4 units, Science 4 units, Social Science 3 units, and Foreign Language or American Sign Language or Computer Science 2 units; students from outside the U.S. system must complete a curriculum deemed equivalent. No CS- or Mechanical Engineering-specific subject requirement is stated.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026Georgia Tech: Academic Preparation
A-Level requirements
Grades
Not recorded
Details
British-patterned applicants submit IGCSE/O-Level results, AS Level results and predicted A-Level results with the application. A-Level exam results are optional to self-report for admission.

Georgia Tech also states that, to be competitive, students should be on track to complete at least 3 full A-levels before enrolling — guidance on competitiveness, not shown as a requirement. No A-Level grade offer is stated.

Verified19 Oct 2026Georgia Tech: International First-Year Admission · Georgia Tech: Standardized Tests
IB requirements
Overall score
Not recorded
Details
Predicted IB scores are strongly recommended; there is no minimum IB score to apply. Higher Level Math and Sciences are encouraged but not required. IB exam results are optional to self-report for admission.

Georgia Tech says competitive IB students have mostly scores of 6 and 7 — guidance on competitiveness, not a minimum, so no score is shown as a requirement.

Verified19 Oct 2026Georgia Tech: International First-Year Admission · Georgia Tech: Standardized Tests
Other qualifications
  • AP exam scores are optional for admission; applicants may self-report them
  • Classic Learning Test (CLT) results may be self-reported as additional information; the CLT does not replace the SAT/ACT requirement
Verified19 Oct 2026Georgia Tech: Standardized Tests · Georgia Tech: Standardized Tests
Other requirements
  • One Common App first-year essay
  • No alumni or admission staff interviews; non-native English speakers may optionally submit a third-party unscripted interview (InitialView or Vericant)
  • No portfolio required for this major (Music Technology is the only major listed as requiring one)
Verified19 Oct 2026Georgia Tech: Personal Essays · Georgia Tech: Interview for International Students · Georgia Tech: Major Selection in the Application Process
